phrase: a Home and Travel Organiser Brand
verdict: Yes. Homestrap from Indore pitched organisers for home and travel on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Organisers are cheap to make, light to ship and rarely returned, and buyers often purchase several at once.
angle: Packing cubes, wardrobe organisers and toiletry bags sell well online, especially before holidays and weddings. Bundles raise order value. Good design and fabric quality set you apart from cheap imports.
